newsitem.title: USA: Toro sees snowthrower sales over $100 million.
newsitem.headline: Toro sees snowthrower sales over $100 million.

text.p: Toro Co., which makes outdoor maintenance equipment, said Friday it expected snowthrower sales this season to exceed $100 million, up from $62 million during October through March last year.

"We've been meeting the demand in most areas," said Don St. Dennis, director of public relations. "But early snowstorms have picked up business significantly. We're virtually sold out in the Northeast and across the snowbelt."
To meet strong demand, Bloomington, Minn.-based Toro also said it was turning some manufacturing lines back to snowthrowers to ensure some supply in January.
Toro's stock rose 62.5 cents to $35.75 on the New York Stock Exchange.
